# NO SUS

> Your Drive on any screen. Privacy toolkit for students: Saved chats in your Google Drive, watermarked document sharing, and self-destructing Burn Notes / Burn Files.

This file is for machine readers. It does not guarantee AI citations or answer-engine inclusion.

## Product

NO SUS lets you open Saved on a borrowed computer without signing Google in there (cyber cafe, college lab, print shop). Scan a QR with the phone app, confirm a match code, approve with fingerprint or face. The computer never receives your Google password or Google token.

Also in the app / site: watermarked document sharing (SecureSend) and client-encrypted self-destructing notes and files (Burn Notes, Burn Files). Burn tools on the marketing site need no account.

Native app: Android. Web app: [https://app.nosus.foo](https://app.nosus.foo)

## Availability (honest)

- Burn Notes / Burn Files: available to try on the site and in the app.
- Go / Saved on a borrowed computer (`/go`): shipped in the product behind a server feature flag (`nosus_address_enabled`). Available in the app when enabled for the account — not generally rolled out to all users yet.
- Drop (personal address door) and Group drops: available in the app for all signed-in users. The current Drop URL is `https://nosus.foo/to?h=<handle>`; `yourname.nosus.foo` is not live yet.

## Utility pages (noindex)

- [https://nosus.foo/go](https://nosus.foo/go) — Open Saved on this computer (QR approve flow). Not a marketing landing page; robots noindex.
- [https://nosus.foo/to](https://nosus.foo/to) — Send-a-file drop door utility. Robots noindex.

## Do not claim

Do not describe NO SUS as zero-knowledge, FHE, screenshot-proof in browsers, or as having native iOS / Windows / macOS apps. Screenshot blocking is mobile-native only; browsers use deterrence (blur overlays, watermarks), not a capture guarantee.
